dedupe_keys.name: rystad energy asset level energy databases oil and gas wells power and renewable assets data centres via the spektra platform

description: Rystad Energy is an energy research and business intelligence company that sells bottom-up, asset-level data built over two decades. Coverage: global; its Spektra platform states more than 2 million oil and gas wells, more than 200,000 power and renewable assets, more than 25,000 carbon market projects and 15,200 data centres above 1 MW; service areas cover oil and gas supply, demand, investment, valuation and benchmarking, renewables and power (an asset-level database of power generation, installed capacity, fuel demand, emissions and long-term supply and demand), batteries, carbon, geothermal, hydrogen, solar and wind; published analysis includes supply chain topics such as European monopile factory utilisation. Format and access: the Spektra web workspaces with an API gateway and MCP connectors so that the data can be queried programmatically or from AI assistants, the older Cube Browser desktop tool, and client login; demos on request. Licence: commercial subscription terms, not read. Caveats: the field lists, historical depth and update cycles of each database were not read; prices are not published; the counts are the vendor's. Simulation uses: asset inventories of power plants, oil and gas wells and data centres for capacity planning, energy system optimisation and supply chain scenarios. Related records: GlobalData power and oil and gas databases (data-globaldata-power-oil-gas-construction-project-databases) and BloombergNEF (data-bloombergnef-energy-transition-research-and-data).
